statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // "?"'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // "?"'); used_pct=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); five_hr=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); seven_d=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); user=$(whoami 2>/dev/null || echo user); host=$(hostname -s 2>/dev/null || echo host); short_cwd="${cwd/#$HOME/\~}"; branch=""; git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 && branch=$(git -C "$cwd" symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || git -C "$cwd" rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); out=$(printf '\033[0;36m%s@%s\033[0m  \033[0;32m%s\033[0m' "$user" "$host" "$short_cwd"); [ -n "$branch" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[0;35m(%s)\033[0m' "$branch")"; out="$out $(printf '\033[0;34m%s\033[0m' "$model")"; [ -n "$used_pct" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[2mctx:\033[0m\033[0;33m%.0f%%\033[0m' "$used_pct")"; rate=""; [ -n "$five_hr" ] && rate=$(printf '5h:%.0f%%' "$five_hr"); [ -n "$seven_d" ] && { [ -n "$rate" ] && rate="$rate "; rate="${rate}$(printf '7d:%.0f%%' "$seven_d")"; }; [ -n "$rate" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[2m%s\033[0m' "$rate")"; echo "$out"
